question: In Table 3, what tumor inhibition rates did TP-siRC@tHyNPs reach in the PMM and the PDX models, and how many percentage points apart are they?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id IN ('p16.T3','p17.T3') AND text ILIKE '%tHyNP%' OR (table_id IN ('p16.T3','p17.T3') AND text ILIKE '%PDX%') OR (table_id IN ('p16.T3','p17.T3') AND text ILIKE '%PMM%')
SELECT id, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p16.T3' AND row_no BETWEEN 9 AND 14 ORDER BY row_no, col_no

WITH a AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text, 'Tumor inhibition rate:\s*([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM cells WHERE id='p16.T3.r10c6'),
b AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text, 'Tumor inhibition rate:\s*([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM cells WHERE id='p16.T3.r12c6')
SELECT ROUND(a.v - b.v, 2) AS diff_pp FROM a, b
